title: Pizza Bill Sum Off-by-One
symptomOutput: Last item price is missing from the calculated total.
explanation: The loop condition `i < prices.length - 1` stops one iteration before the last item. Array indices are 0-based, so the loop must continue while `i < prices.length`. Change the loop condition to include the final element.
hints: Check the loop header condition on line 3.
Look at whether the final element in the array is being included in the sum.

title: Receipt Name Uppercase Formatter
explanation: Strings in JavaScript are immutable, so `.toUpperCase()` returns a new string rather than modifying in-place. The returned value on line 2 was discarded. Returning `name.toUpperCase()` ensures the transformed string is returned.
hints: Look at how string transformation methods work in JavaScript.
Check if strings in JavaScript can be mutated in place.
Should line 2 assign or directly return the result of `name.toUpperCase()`?
